notes: All requirements met: HexagonLayer with count-driven color and elevation, slider 500–5000 (default 1000) rebuilding the layer, LightingEffect + material, CARTO dark-matter basemap, count tooltip, exact initial view; screenshot shows ~140k points aggregated into lit 3D hexagons.
Uses deck.gl 8.9.35 via `new DeckGL({mapLib: maplibregl, mapStyle})` — a v8 pattern; also triggered a blocked request for mapbox-gl.css (harmless). Not v9/MapboxOverlay.

Cartographic weakness: `upperPercentile: 100` with a long-tailed count distribution leaves nearly all hexagons in the lowest cyan bin, so color carries little information outside London; legend is only qualitative Low/High.
